question.problem: Expressed as a fraction in its simplest form, ${log}_{16}⁡(64)$ equals{{field-1}}.

current_example.worked_solution:
We use the change of base formula:

$$
\log_a X = \dfrac {\log_b X} {\log_b a}
$$

In our case, we have $a=16$ and $X =32.$ Since both $a$ and $X$ are powers of $2,$ we set $b=2.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{16}⁡(32) & =\frac{{log}_{2}⁡(32)}{{log}_{2}⁡(16)} \\  & =\frac{{log}_{2}⁡({2}^{5})}{{log}_{2}⁡({2}^{4})} \\  & =\frac{5}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
